title: 第21章 周玫第22章 做噩梦了
slug: 重生后长公主只想种田
content_zh:
;;
沈青鱼却理都没理她，下了马车便朝大门走去。
“沈青鱼，你敢无视本小姐！”周玫震惊，愤怒地冲了上来，伸手就朝沈青鱼推去。
小梨反应很快，在周玫手碰到沈青鱼前，就一把将周玫推开。
“大胆！”
砰！
小梨的力气很大，周玫被推飞出去，重重撞在一根柱子上。
“那么大力气做什么？”沈青鱼皱眉看着，有些心疼地说道，“把柱子撞坏了怎么办？”
周玫正要得意，表情却突然一僵，怀疑自己是不是撞坏了脑袋，听错了话。
本来还有点心虚的小梨一听，顿时眼睛亮了起来。
“殿下放心，那柱子可是金曜石打造的，结实得很。”小梨一边说着，一边偷摸朝周玫扮了个鬼脸。
沈青鱼拍拍胸口：“这样啊，那我放心了。”
主仆几人话音落下，仿佛没有看到周玫一般，抬脚就要进门。
“沈青鱼，你真疯了？”周玫不敢相信，大声叫了起来。
沈青鱼想起了什么，脚步微顿，又转身走了回来。
“殿下？”小梨一脸担忧。
沈青鱼抬了抬手，示意她不用担心。
走至周玫跟前，半蹲下，伸手勾起周玫下巴，仔细地看着她的眼睛。
果然如所猜想的那般，这双眼睛里藏着仇恨与嫉妒。
“你很讨厌本宫，甚至想要本宫死。”

“本小姐没有。”
周玫矢口否认，别过脸去不敢与沈青鱼对视。
沈青鱼也不怎么在意，收回手，拿手帕擦了擦自己的手指。
“你否认也没用，本宫知道你为什么讨厌本宫。”
周玫面色微白，嘴硬道：“你胡说八道。”
沈青鱼自顾自地说道：“你爹娘夫妻不合，你娘久不回上京，偶尔回来也是居住佛堂。”
周玫道：“那又如何，我娘是镇魔司的人，忙跟正常。”
沈青鱼笑笑：“你觉得你爹娘之所以夫妻不合，是因为玉皇后。你父亲对玉皇后爱而不得，所以才会冷落了你娘。”
“沈青鱼，你胡说八道。”
“你恨极了玉皇后，却拿她没有办法，只好把气撒在本宫身上。本宫越是难过，你就越是兴奋满足。周玫，你有点变态啊。”
“……”
周玫脸色煞白如纸，没想到自己心头这般隐秘的事情竟然会被发现，还就这么轻易就说了出来。
沈青鱼站了起来，神色淡漠：“你有没有想过，可能你那龙凤胎哥哥，其实是你同父异母的哥哥。你父亲心头的白月光，其实你哥哥的生母？”
“你胡说，我哥怎么可能不是我哥。”
“是你哥啊，亲的哩！不过是同父异母了而已。你那么爱你哥，肯定不会介意的对吗？还有啊，这事你要是不信的话，可以回去问问你的母亲周夫人哦。”
沈青鱼说完还是没绷住，仰天大笑了几声，这才迈脚入府。
忠勇侯府，还挺好玩的。
身后周玫面色苍白如鬼，一脸不敢置信，张牙舞爪想要扑上去，让沈青鱼改口，承认自己是在胡说八道。

Shen Qingyu ignored her, got off the carriage and walked towards the gate.
"Shen Qingyu, how dare you ignore me!" Zhou Mei was shocked and rushed forward angrily, reaching out and pushing Shen Qingyu.
Xiaoli reacted quickly and pushed Zhou Mei away before Zhou Mei's hand touched Shen Qingyu.
"Be bold!"
Bang!
Xiaoli's strength was so strong that Zhou Mei was pushed away and hit a pillar hard.
"What are you doing with so much effort?" Shen Qingyu frowned and said with some distress, "What if I break the pillar?"
Zhou Mei was about to be proud, but her expression suddenly froze, wondering if she had damaged her head and heard the wrong words.
Xiaoli, who was still a little guilty, suddenly lit up when she heard this.
"Don't worry, Your Highness, that pillar is made of golden obsidian and is very strong." Xiaoli said while secretly making a face at Zhou Mei.
Shen Qingyu patted his chest: "That's it, then I'm relieved."
After the master and servants finished speaking, they raised their feet to enter the door as if they had not seen Zhou Mei.
"Shen Qingyu, are you really crazy?" Zhou Mei couldn't believe it and shouted loudly.
Shen Qingyu thought of something, paused slightly, turned around and walked back.
"Your Highness?" Xiaoli looked worried.
Shen Qingyu raised his hand to signal her not to worry.
Walking to Zhou Mei, he squatted down, reached out to lift Zhou Mei's chin, and looked into her eyes carefully.
As expected, there was hatred and jealousy hidden in these eyes.
"You hate me so much that you even want me to die."
"I don't have it, Miss."
Zhou Mei denied it, turning away and not daring to look at Shen Qingyu.
Shen Qingyu didn't pay much attention. He took back his hand and wiped his fingers with a handkerchief.
"It's useless for you to deny it. I know why you hate me."
Zhou Mei's face turned slightly pale and she said harshly: "You are talking nonsense."
Shen Qingyu said to herself: "Your father and mother are not getting along. Your mother has not been back to Beijing for a long time. When she comes back, she stays in the Buddhist hall."
Zhou Mei said: "So what, my mother is from the Demon Suppression Division, so it's normal to be busy."
Shen Qingyu smiled: "You think the reason why your parents don't get along is because of the Jade Queen. Your father loves the Jade Queen, so he neglects your mother."
"Shen Qingyu, you are talking nonsense."
"You hate the Jade Queen so much, but you have no choice but to vent your anger on me. The more sad I am, the more excited and satisfied you are. Zhou Mei, you are a bit perverted."
"..."
Zhou Mei's face turned as white as paper. She didn't expect that such a secret thing in her heart would be discovered and she would say it out so easily.
Shen Qingyu stood up with an indifferent expression: "Have you ever thought that maybe your twin brother is actually your half-brother. The white moonlight in your father's heart is actually your brother's biological mother?"
"You're talking nonsense, how could my brother not be my brother?"
"It's your brother, dear! He's just a half-brother. You love your brother so much, you won't mind, right? Also, if you don't believe this, you can go back and ask your mother, Mrs. Zhou."
After Shen Qingyu finished speaking, she still didn't hold back. She laughed a few times and then stepped into the house.
Zhongyong Hou Mansion is quite fun.
Behind her, Zhou Mei looked as pale as a ghost, with a look of disbelief on her face. She bared her teeth and claws, trying to pounce on Shen Qingyu and make her change her words and admit that she was talking nonsense.
